Name: Lasting Conversation Topics
Author: sophiesalacia
Description:
[center][i]﻿[img]https://imgur.com/BkKvjWw.png[/img]
﻿
by sophie
[/i][/center]
[size=3]
This mod extends the length of certain conversation topics to be indefinite, so that NPCs can comment on them at any point. This is beneficial if you tend not to talk to NPCs in a timely manner, or have a lot of NPCs in your game to talk to. It also works well with NPCs that show up later in the game, such as Kent.

By default, the only conversation topic extended is the Introduction topic, so NPCs will be able to introduce themselves whenever you talk to them. However, [b]it is highly recommended that you install the additional content pack by LenneDalben (found under Optional Files)[/b], so that numerous other conversation topics are extended as well.

The content pack kindly provided by LenneDalben extends many conversation topics, both vanilla and modded:

It extends the following vanilla conversation topics:
[/size][list]
[*][size=3]Completing the CC[/size]
[/list][list]
[*][size=3]Beginning the CC[/size]
[/list][list]
[*][size=3]Finishing specific bundles[/size]
[/list][list]
[*][size=3]Pam's house upgrade[/size]
[/list][size=3]
It extends the topics added by the following mods:
[/size][list]
[*][size=3]More Conversation Topics[/size]
[*][size=3]Pumpkin Spice Madness[/size]
[*][size=3]Platonic Letters[/size]
[*][size=3]Host Trees[/size]
[*][size=3]Townies Need Artisan Goods (Available on Moddrop only)[/size]
[/list]

[img]https://imgur.com/Zoh3NLN.png[/img]

[list=1]
[*][size=3][url=https://smapi.io]Install the latest version of SMAPI[/url].[/size]
[*][size=3]Download this mod and unzip it into [font=Courier New]Stardew Valley/Mods[/font].[/size]
[*][size=3]Run the game using SMAPI.[/size]
[/list][size=3]
Alternatively, if you are using a mod manager, download using your mod manager of choice (I recommend [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/skyrimspecialedition/mods/6194]Mod Organizer 2[/url] with the [url=https://github.com/ModOrganizer2/modorganizer-basic_games]Simple Games Plugin[/url]).[/size]


[img]https://imgur.com/SSTU8G5.png[/img]
[size=3]
[/size][list]
[*][size=3]Works with Stardew Valley 1.6 on Windows. Linux/Mac have not been tested, but[/size]
[size=3] should work. Earlier game versions have not been tested, but should work. Please report any issues you encounter.[/size][*][size=3]Works in single player and multiplayer. Again, multiplayer has not been extensively [/size]
[size=3]tested, so please report any issues you encounter.

If you want to use this mod on 1.5.6, use version 0.2.1. Any bugs or issues reported on that version will [b]NOT[/b] be fixed, it's just available for those who don't want to update to 1.6 yet.
